title: Mutual Information Divergence: A Unified Metric for Multimodal Generative Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the metric's sensitivity to learned biases (which cause models to hallucinate objects based on training co-occurrences) by using the FOIL-COCO dataset to test whether the proposed metric correctly assigns higher scores to ground-truth captions compared to "foiled" captions where a single noun-phrase has been swapped.
